title: Is the request clear and complete?

intent.description: yes when the message starts or changes what is to be built; no for a question, an answer, a remark.

topic.description: A few words naming the request in the person's own terms.

proposal.description: One to three sentences saying what you will do, in the person's own words.

wont.description: The one thing you will not do that rules out something the person might expect.

assumptions.description: Small gaps that change nothing important about what gets built, each as a plain assumption.

gaps.description: Only the gaps that change what gets built, the most important first.

id.description: A short stable key for the question, such as format or scope.

recommended.description: Position in suggestions of the one you recommend.

consequences.description: One line per suggestion, parallel to suggestions: what picking it means.

blocking.description: true only when no suggestion is better supported by the conversation, the records and the code AND a wrong pick is costly to undo.

diagram.description: true only when the question is about which parts talk to which, an order of steps, or where something lives; false for wording or scope.

gap.description: true when gaps is not empty.

answers.description: Set only when the message clearly answers a question just put to the person: one option picked, or a plain yes or no to one proposal shown whole.

question.description: The question in the last reply the message answers.

evidence.description: The person's exact words that answer it, copied from the message.

also.description: The new request the message adds besides the answer, in the person's words; leave out when the whole message is the answer.

options.description: With question, only when its answer would confirm, reject or change a record, choose a conflict's side or settle a stale link: the options the last reply offered (a plain yes or no are two).

effect.description: What choosing it does to the record: confirms it as it reads, drops it, or changes it.

picked.description: With options: the label of the option the person chose, copied from options.

records.description: With options: ids of the records the question is about, as given in touched.
